text: Reviewed PR #5329 (workspace-agent layout lifecycle test isolation) via /code-review: one real finding, posted as a PR comment. Extraction itself verified byte-for-byte identical (independently fetched and diffed removed block vs new .inl content), CMake contract-check correctly reconstructs validation text, CI workflow path-filter update correct. The finding: CHANGELOG.md/agent-handoff.md say the module covers RQ-CF-AGENT-014/016/018/020/021, but the moved tests actually reference -012/-013/-014/-015/-016/-020/-021 -- 018 doesn't appear anywhere (it's a distinct, unrelated requirement per an existing agent-handoff.md entry from #5319), while 012/013/015 are used extensively but omitted from the list. Same wrong list duplicated in both docs -- would misdirect a future traceability search. Not fixed, your branch.
